Hi Priya / Samir — quick technical notes ahead of the session:

- For the short load test we'll run a 3-phase ramp: 0->50rps (2m), 50->200rps (3m), sustain 200rps for 10m, then cool down. We'll capture token-level latency and kv-cache hit rates.
- If you plan to test with long context prompts (>2k tokens), let us know; runtime kernel selection depends on sequence length distribution.
- For VPCs: outbound to our public inference endpoints requires that your egress allow 52.45.12.0/24 (example IP block) and TLS to port 443. If you want private deployment we can coordinate a VPN/peering but that adds ~2–3 days.

I'll attach loadtest-plan-100k-steps.yaml and a short checklist for the engineers. If you can run a quick curl from one of your hosts to https://status.redwood.ai/health we can validate connectivity before the call.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
